passage.label: Indeed Day Judgement appointed time; Day Horn blown come forth multitudes; heaven opened become gateways; mountains removed become mirage; Indeed Hell lying wait; transgressors place return; remain ages unending; not taste coolness drink; except scalding water foul purulence; appropriate recompense; Indeed not expecting account; denied verses emphatic denial; enumerated everything writing; taste penalty never increase except torment

arabicExcerpts.text: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجٗا
لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدٗا وَلَا شَرَابًا

mainSubject.label: The Day of Judgement declared an appointed time when the Horn is blown and multitudes come forth, heaven opens into gateways and mountains vanish like a mirage; Hell lying in wait for transgressors as their place of return where they remain for unending ages tasting neither coolness nor drink except scalding water and foul purulence as appropriate recompense; they did not expect an account and denied the verses emphatically, yet everything has been enumerated in writing — taste the penalty with no increase except torment
